categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet migration code across src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/db.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents database corruption and loss of original wallet files during legacy-to-descriptor migration failures. In current master, 'MigrateToSQLite deleted original BDB databases before verifying that SQLite database creation succeeded' and stale journal files could cause SQLite to write 'pages of an unrelated database into it' upon replacement.
